maria: Quick sync  we need a simple handoff pattern for SI co-sell leads coming from Marketplace and HW partners. Yesterday we had 2 dropped leads between SI <> AE. Proposal: single source-of-truth mapping + 48h SLA for claim or escalate.

devon: +1. can we enforce via SFDC queue? sharing a CSV template below.

maria: paste CSV sample?

devon: ```
acct_id,acct_name,region,assigned_AE,si_partner,si_owner,si_consent,handoff_ts,source
12345,Acme Corp,NA,devon,ClearStack,jonas,true,2026-08-01T14:32:00Z,marketplace
```

jonas: FYI SI side wants an 'opt-in' tag before we push to their queue. can we add `si_consent` boolean? makes reporting cleaner.

rachel: revops: yes  we can add checkbox + validation rule. also build a report: Unclaimed SI leads >24h and Dashboard: SI queue health.

maria: rough timeline for revops?

rachel: i can prototype the SFDC route + validation and a basic report by Tue EOD. will flag limits for enterprise thresholds.

devon: for Rules of Engagement (draft): 1) SI has 48h to claim a co-sell lead after handoff; 2) AE remains opportunity owner until SI claim; 3) joint intro call within 7 days of claim; 4) if unclaimed after 48h, escalate to Partner Ops.

jonas: works for most. request: strategic deals (>$500k ARR) get 24h claim SLA and a direct pager to SI lead.

maria: ok add threshold exception. also add a consent UX: when Marketplace lead opts into SI assistance we set `si_consent=true` and auto-route.

devon: i'll add the CSV template + a short ingest script to Confluence and the partner-runbook. link to be added: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Partnerships/SI+Handoff
